{{Money|900}} (Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 0% |music-1 = '''Ambient''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Snow Jumper|thumb|250px|center]] |music-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Mecha-claus]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Carol of The Bots|thumb|250px|center]] |music-ingame-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Mecha-claus]])''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Carol of the Bots In-Game Version|thumb|250px|center]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Cold Ambush''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the [[Violent Night Event]]. It briefly returned through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it was later removed, likely due to how broken it was. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with {{Money|800}}, and an extra {{Money|100}} if the player is in the [https://www.roblox.com/communities/4914494/Paradoxum-Games#!/about Paradoxum Games group]. at the start of the game. Upon triumphing, you were awarded {{Coins|280}}, {{Exp|70}} and the [[Elf Camp]] tower on the first triumph. This map used the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] as its narrator. This map had the [[HP Locked]] and [[Mutation]] modifiers. The [[HP Locked]] modifier set the base health to 200 when starting the game, though the base health could be increased by buying plots. The [[Mutation]] modifier increased the health of enemies each wave after their debut in the form of shield health by 4% of their normal health. On Waves ??? and ❄️, an entirely different mechanic was used instead of [[Mutation]] due to these waves being endless. Enemies would have their normal health increase over time instead. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, none of these were applied anymore. The enemy income shared similar functions with [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore mode]]. You could only receive cash after the enemy was defeated, and the amount of cash received depended on how much damage your own towers had dealt. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it used the regular income system other modes use. The map had passive income and passive base health regeneration. Every 30 seconds, you would have gained cash which you could have used to purchase more towers and heal back your base health, if it was damaged. It also had purchasable plots. When purchased, they gave the player new cliff or ground spots for the player to place towers on. It also increased your base health, passive income and passive base health regeneration. None of this works in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode anymore. ==Design & Path== '''Cold Ambush''' was a village during the winter season. In the middle, there was a Christmas tree. The Christmas tree gained more decorations the higher your base health was during the [[Violent Night Event]]. Near the Christmas tree, there were multiple plots that you could buy, which would turn into ground spots, with some plots also turning into ground spots with stone structures that could be used as cliff spots. This did not work in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Multiple wooden fences surrounded the middle part of the map. On the outer side of the map, there was a large forest with a small village in it, which had multiple wooden buildings of various sizes. A dirt path connected the buildings, with multiple lanterns being visible on the sides of them. In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, multiple parts of the map had large, translucent blocks on them. Enemies spawned on the outer side of the map, going onto the Christmas tree, which was the exit. The [[Ripped Elf (Cold Ambush)|Ripped Elf]], [[Gatekeeper (Cold Ambush)|Gatekeeper]] and [[Mecha-claus]] walked around the plots, never walking into the exit. Enemies and units did not spawn in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Cold Ambush}} ==Story== An unknown force takes over minds of the elves and turns them against [[Santa]]. After overthrowing him, the elves use their Christmas magic and cheer to turn toys into weapons and inanimate festive objects, like the [[Gingerbread (Cold Ambush)|Gingerbread]] and [[Snowman (Cold Ambush)|Snowmen]], into enemies. By the end, they build up a giant [[Mecha-claus]]. Mrs. Claus after realizing this comes to get help from the [[T.D.S. Organization]] to save her husband and Christmas as a whole. [[T.D.S. Organization]] sends the [[Commander]], [[Scout]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Engineer]] to defeat them, which they successfully do. In the trailer, it is heavily implied that [[Lord Exo]] was the one who mind controlled the elves. Why [[Lord Exo]] had to overthrow [[Santa]] is never elaborated on, however. ==Event Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x. Any rewards that end in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|100}} × (Waves/26)^1.75 + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.4 |Waves 1-9: Waves Completed × {{Exp|1.923}}
Waves 10-❄️: Waves Completed × {{Exp|0.962}} |} In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no rewards could be gotten. ===Badges=== There was also one [[badges|badge]] you could obtain when playing this map, which had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. It was: {{Badge |title = Defeat Mecha-clause! |description = An unknown force is controlling the mind of the elves.. Destroy their secret weapon and save Christmas! |rewards = [[Elf Camp]] |image = DefeatMechaClauseBadge.png |obtainable = No }} ==Plots== Plots could be bought during the [[Violent Night Event]], though none of them worked in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. There were in total 16 plots that you could purchase. There were two types of plots you could buy. The first plot was the plot space, where you get rid of snow. These were cheaper and only provided ground spots. The second plot was the cliff space, where you rebuilt stone, on which you could place cliff towers. These were more expensive, but they provided new ground spots and cliff spots. Additionally, enemies and units would not travel on cliff spaces, regardless of whether they were bought or not. There were 9 plot spaces and 7 cliff spaces. You started off with 200 base health, {{Money|0}} passive income and 0 passive base health regeneration, which you could increase by buying plots. When all plots have been purchased, you would have 800 base health, {{Money|3,400}} passive income and 72 passive base health regeneration. There were two rows of plots, all of which had 8 plots. Each row became more expensive than the previous, but provided higher increase of the passive income, base health and passive base health regeneration. This list details how much each plot increased these statistics by: {| class="wikitable pad-5" style="text-align: center; margin:10px auto; width:800px;" ! colspan="6" |Plot Spaces |- !Row !Amount !Cost !Passive Income Increase !Base Health Regen Increase !Base Health Increase |- |1 |6 |{{Money|600}} |{{Money|125}} |3 |25 |- |2 |3 |{{Money|2,500}} |{{Money|300}} |6 |50 |} {| class="wikitable pad-5" style="text-align: center; margin:10px auto; width:800px;" |- ! colspan="6" |Cliff Spaces |- !Row !Amount !Cost !Passive Income Increase !Base Health Regen Increase !Base Health Increase |- |1 |2 |{{Money|850}} |{{Money|125}} |3 |25 |- |2 |5 |{{Money|3,500}} |{{Money|300}} |6 |50 |} ==Event Wave Structure== The formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|180}} + ({{Money|75}} × Waves Completed)) ÷ Players Players did not get a wave bonus when the wave ??? ended. The waves in '''Cold Ambush''' followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="margin:0 auto; width:50%" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-11 |1:00 |0:19Skip at 0:40. |- |12 |2:00 |0:39Skip at 1:20. |- |13-23 |1:00 |0:19Skip at 0:40. |- |24 |2:00 |0:39Skip at 1:20. |- |??? |0:00 |N/A |- |❄️ |100:00 |N/A |} Due to the unique nature of '''Cold Ambush''', the number of enemies that spawned would be extremely hard to count. Additionally, past Wave 24, if the last plot of land was not bought, the game continued in perpetuity. Therefore, the list details the enemy's debut wave and wave dialogue. ----

==Event Strategy== *It is necessary to purchase plots around the map to increase the passive income, base heath and health regeneration. **Purchasing all plots will trigger wave ❄️ and spawn [[Mecha-claus]]. You can leave one plot unpurchased if you need additional time to prepare. ***This is usually not recommended because you will get less passive money and passive base health regeneration from the map, which may cause you to lose on earlier waves. ***Until you purchase the final plot, the game will be in an endless mode. Enemies will spawn endlessly with increasing health over time. ***Use this to your advantage to heal base health before activating the last wave. *Towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Cowboy]], [[Golden Cowboy]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are recommended for the earlier waves. *Although you do have a lot of health in this map, it is recommended to not let many enemies get to the exit, due to multiple enemies having abilities that damage your base health by a high amount *The [[Medic]] is recommended to heal your base health, as many enemies may leak through. **It can also be useful later on in cleansing your towers from stuns. *Towers like the [[Executioner]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]] can be useful in killing the [[Sleigh (Cold Ambush)|Sleigh]]s. **The [[Executioner]] can also help with killing large hordes of enemies early-mid game, being nearly an all-rounder. *High DPS towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Ranger]] are needed for later Waves. *The [[Farm]] and [[Ace Pilot]] are disabled in this map, meaning you cannot place them. You should not add them to your loadout, if you are planning to play on this map. *Towers with short range, such as the [[Gladiator]], [[Sledger]] and [[Warden]] will not be effective on this map, due to the enemies coming from all sides. ==Trivia== *The base triumph rewards on this map were {{Coins|200}}, {{Exp|50}} and the [[Elf Camp]]. However, because of the [[Mutation]] and [[HP Locked]], you never actually received this amount of {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}}, as modifiers increased it by 40%. *This was the second map to have objectives, following [[D00M's Revenge]]. **This was also the second map to have purchasable plots, passive cash income, and a base in the center of the map, also following [[D00M's Revenge]]. **This was the first map to have passive base health regeneration. *'''Cold Ambush''' had the highest amount of paths in the game, being 44. *The position of the trees on this map were randomly determined in each match. ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Cold Ambush''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Cold Ambush''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Cold Ambush''' re-added as a selectable map in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} '''Cold Ambush''' is completely unplayable as no enemies or units can spawn. **{{Bug}} [[Farm]] and [[Ace Pilot]] remain disabled even after exiting the map in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **{{Bug}} In [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, multiple parts of the map have large, translucent blocks on them. **{{Bug}} '''Cold Ambush''' uses the first icon of [[Abandoned City]] in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''8 January 2025''' - [[v1.48.0]] **'''Cold Ambush''' removed. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Short Maps]]
